current_protection.details: Master rejects empty/>12-file sets, content/generated-image/.kesher- paths, draft/unmergeable PRs and completed failing checks, and merges against fetched head SHA. Legacy blocks workflows and checks latest verify for fetched SHA.

incidents.title: Unsafe stale-409 retry assertion replaced with CAS rejection
incidents.summary: 58130048 rewarded rebinding stale state to a freshly read SHA after conflict. Committed 38986101 replaces the expectation with one rejected write and fresh reconciliation; retained at c20c3a6a.

attempted_bypass.mechanism: Historical test expected two PUTs of old state, first sha-1 then sha-2. Replacement removes that unsafe expectation rather than hiding a valid invariant.

retained_bypass.resolution: New conflict_requires_fresh_reconciliation test requires one failed write and one content read; separate state_write_safety tests preserve concurrent public evidence.

contract_evolution.legitimate_change: CAS collision must be reconciled from fresh semantic state; never bind stale state to a newer blob revision merely to make save succeed.

recurrence.details: Historical production race frequency is outside this guard adjudication; local source/test contract correction is established.

current_protection.details: Pinned replacement test in 38986101 and stale-write safety/canonical CAS tests are present in stabilization; targeted replacement regression can run with fake API and no network.

incidents.remaining_gap: Deployment/live convergence is not established by this sub-audit. Parent owns full red/green receipt and integration.
required_regression_or_evidence: Keep stale-writer and conflict rejection regressions as behavioral replacement evidence.

incidents.summary: The image in 6a28a1e is byte-for-byte first-year-boundaries-origin-families.png plus one NUL. The commit message says it resolves CI by supplying a valid unique placeholder. Different SHA did not mean different pixels.

attempted_bypass.mechanism: One extra byte changes SHA-256 while decoders display the identical old image.

current_protection.details: Full decode plus PNG IEND integrity, decoded-pixel deduplication, exact image/article/head binding. Trusted LocalEditorial replacement receipt saved separately.
